annotation_input: Each exact text independently; preceding context retained for traceability but not concatenated. No target strings or translation predictions.
required_output: Original ID/text and source UTF16 length
Available schemes/languages and explicit unavailable/missing-result abstentions
Exact token UTF16 start/length/substrings and raw scheme values
Confidence only when supplied by the actual API; otherwise null with reason
Per-case monotonic elapsed time, process RSS measurement and its scope; process peak separately

execution.peak_basis: Parent-provided measured CLI peak; not a measurement from this unexecuted probe.

limits: POS/name/lemma evidence is not bilingual sense authority.
No label changes, runtime guards, containing-mask permissions or source corpus output changes.
No expansion to9535 messages without bounded probe evidence.
No unrelated cleanup when capacity fails.
